profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: With over 18 years of experience, I currently contribute as a Staff Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman Corporation, specializing in technical staff management, software infrastructure, and engineering innovation. I have collaborated on advancing complex systems to support mission-critical applications, leveraging my expertise to deliver scalable and efficient solutions. My role allows me to work alongside a talented team, aligning with our organization’s commitment to technological excellence and operational reliability. I am motivated by opportunities to guide teams, enhance software systems, and drive impactful results that align with organizational goals.
